presets.title: Presets
presets.help: Save the current Studio settings as a preset. Only settings that differ from the defaults are stored, so later default changes still reach everything a preset leaves alone. Right-click a preset (or Shift+F10) to apply, edit or overwrite it. Media, projects and running jobs are never replaced.
presets.name: Preset name
presets.loaded: Preset applied. Settings it does not change are at their defaults.
presets.invalid: This preset contains settings this version cannot use. Nothing was changed; open Edit to fix or remove them.
presets.tileHint: Right-click or Shift+F10: Apply, Edit, Overwrite
presets.showAll: Also show settings at their default
presets.unknown: Not used by this version; the preset cannot be applied until removed.
presets.invalidValue: Not a valid value for this setting.
